Kepadatan kerang lumpur Anodontia edentula Linnaeus, 1758 kaitannya dengan parameter lingkungan di Kabupaten Muna

Penelitian bertujuan menganalisis kepadatan kerang lumpur Anodontia edentula Linnaeus, 1758 kaitannya dengan parameter lingkungan meliputi kandungan bahan organik dan komposisi sedimen di Kabupaten Muna. Penelitian dilaksanakan di pulau Tobea dan pesisir Lambiku. Pengambilan sampel dimulai bulan Maret sampai Mei 2011 dengan interval waktu koleksi contoh sebulan sekali selama tiga bulan. Koleksi kerang lumpur contoh menggunakan metode plot trasek (Line Transect Plot) yang ditentukan secara sengaja (purposive sampling). Plot pengamatan dibagi atas tiga kategori, yakni Plot I mewakili daerah dekat pantai, Plot II mewakili daerah peralihan dan Plot III mewakili daerah jauh dari pantai dengan interval 50 m masing-masing plot. Analisis data kepadatan menggunakan formula Krebs, hubungan kepadatan dan parameter lingkungan menggunakan analisis korelasi dan deskriptif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan kepadatan individu kerang lumpur di pulau Tobea berbeda dengan kepadatan individu kerang lumpur di pesisir Lambiku. Kepadatan kerang lumpur di pulau Tobea lebih tinggi, yakni rata-rata sebesar 33 ind m-2 atau 29-40 ind m-2. Sementara kepadatan kerang lumpur di pesisir Lambiku lebih rendah yakni sebesar 10 ind m-2 atau 8-11 ind m-2. Kepadatan individu kerang lumpur antara daerah jauh dari pantai dengan daerah yang dekat pantai relatif berbeda. Sementara komposisi sedimen dan kandungan bahan organik di pulau Tobea dan pesisir Lambiku relatif sama. Konsentrasi fosfat dan sulfur di pulau Tobea masing-masing sebesar 13,90 ppm dan 15,76 ppm. Konsentrasi fosfat dan sulfur di pesisir Lambiku masing-masing sebesar 14,55 ppm dan 17,01 ppm. Daerah yang jauh dari pantai menunjukkan kandungan bahan organik sulfur dan fosfat yang tinggi dengan kepadatan kerang lumpur tinggi.

Featured Content

  • Gonad maturity stage using morphological analysis of the endemic pirik fish (Lagusia micracanthus Bleeker, 1860) from Pattunuang rivers, South Sulawesi

    Pirik fish (Lagusia micracanthus) is an endemic freshwater fish in South Sulawesi Province, Indonesia. This research aimed to study stage of gonad maturity in the morphology. This study was conductued in September 2014 to February 2015 at Pattunuang rivers, Samangki village, Maros Regency. Sample analysis was conductued at the Fisheries Biology Laboratory, Departement of Fisheries, Hasanuddin University, Makassar. The result were, the stage of gonad maturity is composed of five stages, namely Stage I (immature), Stage II (maturing), Stage III (mature), Stage IV (fully mature) and Stage V (resting).

  • The use of fatty acid omega-3 HUFA and ecdyson hormone to improve of larval stage indeks and survival rate of mud crab Scylla olivacea

    Mud crab Scylla olivacea a fishery commodities with high economic value. The survival rate is still low, especially the crab larvae stadia zoea until megalopa. Supplementation on rotifers and Artemia with fatty acids omega-3 HUFA and hormones ecdyson able to increase the survival rate. The aim of research to analyze the performance of developmental and larval survival rate of mud crab supplemented omega-3 fatty acids, Nannochloropsis and hormones ecdyson. The results of the research as an innovative engineering technology physiological mangrove crab larvae in order to increase the production of seed suistainable. This study will be conducted at the Research Station Maranak, Research and Development of Brackish Water Aquaculture Maros (BPPBAP Maros). Test animals used in the form of mangrove crab larvae stadia zoea-1. Aquarium research container in the form of capacity of 50 L. Larvae density of 50 larvae/L. Stage larval indeks and survival rate of test parameters. The study design in the form of RAL with 3 treatments namely omega-3 HUFA, hormon ecdyson, Nannocholoropsis and without supplementation as a control, 3 replicates that will be analyzed by ANOVA. The results showed that the type of material supplementation significantly (P<0.05) against the larval stage index and survival rate of mud crab larvae.

  • Analysis of sea surface temperature, salinity and current with the yellowfin tuna cathced on Western Halmahera Island Waters

    There are many oceanography parameters that affects migration and the presence of tuna in a waters such as temperature, salinity, sea current and sea waters fertility. A number of studies get that the distribution of tuna was predictable by analysis of those parameters at sea waters regularly and mapped to support the activity of localytuna fisheries. In the western of North Molucas waters, all of this parameter was predicted is also formed so that can be used as indicators of the presence of tuna. The study was conducted at the western water of Halmahera island over August to October 2015 with the objective of knowing the relationship between sea surface temperature, salinity and sea current to the tuna catched in this region. Data acquisition by using suvey method and analyzed by multiple linier regression analysis was expected to define the ralation between sea surface temperature, salinity, the sea current with the catch yellowfin the tuna. The results of the study got that in the jointing of the third oceanography factors being tested give significant impact to tuna catched with Fcount value is 3,317 with it's significant value is 0,000. But it is partial only two factors ocenographywho had have real impact on tuna catched, which are sea surface temperature and sea current at these waters.

  • Uji daya simpan prototype kit vibriosis "RICA"

    Research on the biomolecular detection of vibriosis have managed to find a specific marker of luminiscent pathogenic Vibrio that the infect specific penaeid shrimp. This specific gene-based marker haemolysin (IAVh). Optimization test indicated that the IAVh primer specific for the detection of vibriosis in shrimp Penaeid with sensitivity is to the density of bacteria 101-102 CFU/mL. The time required for the detection of vibriosis using the AIVh marker is only 1 to 2 days. Furthermore, a prototype detection Kit has been prepared based on PCR method using IAVh primer as its main component and pathogen genomes V. harveyi RICA collection as a positive control. This study aimed to test the storage time of the prototype components Kit vibriosis "RICA". Component Kit consists of two types of mixture. The composition of the first mixture comparises: Taq Buffer dNTP + ddH2O. While the composition of the second mixture comparising a mixture of: Taq DNA Polymerase + buffer + ddH2O. Both kinds of mixed composition are each stored at a temperature of -20oC and -80oC. At the time of PCR process will be implemented, will be added primer and Taq DNA Polymerase for composition 1 and primer and dNTP for composition 2. In the PCR test is used genome of a pure culture of Vibrio pathogens and genomes of diseased organ infection with Vibrio pathogens. The results showed that the composition prototype vibriosis detection kit is the best mixed composition 2 consist of Taq DNA Polymerase + Buffer Taq + ddH2O. The storage temperature is the best: -20oC with optimum storage time for 6 months.

    • Struktur dan komposisi jenis mangrove Desa Bonea dan Kodiri, Kabupaten Muna, Sulawesi Tenggara

      Kondisi ekosistem mangrove di desa Kodiri dengan kondisi baik, karena upaya pengelolaan yang telah dilakukan masyarakat adat secara swadaya. Mangrove di desa Bonea tergolong rusak, karena tingginya tingkat pemanfaatan khususnya pengambilan kayu bakar. Penelitian bertujuan untuk menganalisis struktur dan komposisi vegetasi mangrove di desa Bonea Kecamatan Lasalepa dan desa Kodiri Kecamatan Lohia. Parameter kerapatan relatif, penutupan relatif, penutupan relatif jenis dan Indeks Nilai Penting (INP) digunakan sebagai indikator untuk menggambarkan struktur dan komposisi vegetasi mangrove. Penelitian dilakukan pada bulan Juni sampai bulan Desember 2014 bertempat di pesisir desa Bonea dan desa Kodiri. Analisis data dilakukan di Laboratorium Perikanan STIP Wuna Raha. Pengamatan vegetasi mangrove menggunakan metode kombinasi garis lurus (line transect) dan berpetak sebanyak 3 (tiga) titik pengamatan pada setiap lokasi. Titik pengamatan ditentukan secara sengaja (purposive), berdasarkan keterwakilan kodisi vegetasi mangrove yang dikaji, sehingga terdapat 6 jalur dan 18 petak pengamatan pada dua lokasi. Data vegetasi mangrove dianalisis secara deskriptif-kualitatif. Hasil penelitian, ditemukan vegetasi mangrove di desa Bonea didominasi Ceriops tagal dan Rhizophora apiculata. Penutupan relatif jenis kategori rusak dan kerapatan jenis kategori jarang. Vegetasi mangrove desa Kodiri didominasi Rhizophora apiculata, Soneratia alba, Bruguera sexangula, Rhizophora stylosa, Soneratia caseolaris, Bruguera gymnorhiza, dan Avicenia marina. Nilai penutupan relatif jenis kategori baik dan kerapatan relatif jenis kategori jarang.

      • Rochmady RochmadyRochmady
      Ekosistem Laut, Pesisir dan Pulau-Pulau KecilOA05 Oct 2015

  • Estimated value of economic losses caused water pollution on Mahakam Coastal area

    This study aimed to quantify the value of environmental damage caused by coastal development activities based on the cost of replacement the environment in the coastal Kutai Kertanegara. The data used in this study is the measurement of the field, interviews as well as data that originates in the department of Fisheries, Tourism and Local Government Kutai Kertanegara. Data were processed using the environment against the economic valuation approach coastal waters Kutai Kertanegara followed by dynamic analysis. The result showed that the Total Economic Value of mangrove ecosystems in the Mahakam Delta area with an area of ±150,000 ha is Rp. 4,203,100,332,500/year or Rp. 28,020,669/ha/year. The direct benefits of mangrove ecosystem that is used by people around the region provides the larges contribution of Rp. 1,871,967,115,-. Our simulation results show that the amount of comensation that incurred by each industry Rp. 2.254.196.642/year and impaired to Rp. 2.039.938.021/year, while the compensation/pollution tax for the loss in production that should be Rp. 214,941,877,125/year, borne by each of pollutant sources and community the mining industry worth USD 514,162,739/year.

Sementara komposisi sedimen dan kandungan bahan organik di pulau Tobea dan pesisir Lambiku relatif sama. Konsentrasi fosfat dan sulfur di pulau Tobea masing-masing sebesar 13,90 ppm dan 15,76 ppm. Konsentrasi fosfat dan sulfur di pesisir Lambiku masing-masing sebesar 14,55 ppm dan 17,01 ppm. Daerah yang jauh dari pantai menunjukkan kandungan bahan organik sulfur dan fosfat yang tinggi dengan kepadatan kerang lumpur tinggi.

    Ekosistem Laut, Pesisir Dan Pulau-Pulau KecilOpen AccessP: 149-15930 Sep 2016

  • Uji daya simpan prototype kit vibriosis "RICA"

    Research on the biomolecular detection of vibriosis have managed to find a specific marker of luminiscent pathogenic Vibrio that the infect specific penaeid shrimp. This specific gene-based marker haemolysin (IAVh). Optimization test indicated that the IAVh primer specific for the detection of vibriosis in shrimp Penaeid with sensitivity is to the density of bacteria 101-102 CFU/mL. The time required for the detection of vibriosis using the AIVh marker is only 1 to 2 days. Furthermore, a prototype detection Kit has been prepared based on PCR method using IAVh primer as its main component and pathogen genomes V. harveyi RICA collection as a positive control. This study aimed to test the storage time of the prototype components Kit vibriosis "RICA". Component Kit consists of two types of mixture. The composition of the first mixture comparises: Taq Buffer dNTP + ddH2O. While the composition of the second mixture comparising a mixture of: Taq DNA Polymerase + buffer + ddH2O. Both kinds of mixed composition are each stored at a temperature of -20oC and -80oC. At the time of PCR process will be implemented, will be added primer and Taq DNA Polymerase for composition 1 and primer and dNTP for composition 2. In the PCR test is used genome of a pure culture of Vibrio pathogens and genomes of diseased organ infection with Vibrio pathogens. The results showed that the composition prototype vibriosis detection kit is the best mixed composition 2 consist of Taq DNA Polymerase + Buffer Taq + ddH2O. The storage temperature is the best: -20oC with optimum storage time for 6 months.

  • Gonad maturity stage using morphological analysis of the endemic pirik fish (Lagusia micracanthus Bleeker, 1860) from Pattunuang rivers, South Sulawesi

    Pirik fish (Lagusia micracanthus) is an endemic freshwater fish in South Sulawesi Province, Indonesia. This research aimed to study stage of gonad maturity in the morphology. This study was conductued in September 2014 to February 2015 at Pattunuang rivers, Samangki village, Maros Regency. Sample analysis was conductued at the Fisheries Biology Laboratory, Departement of Fisheries, Hasanuddin University, Makassar. The result were, the stage of gonad maturity is composed of five stages, namely Stage I (immature), Stage II (maturing), Stage III (mature), Stage IV (fully mature) and Stage V (resting).

  • The use of fatty acid omega-3 HUFA and ecdyson hormone to improve of larval stage indeks and survival rate of mud crab Scylla olivacea

    Mud crab Scylla olivacea a fishery commodities with high economic value. The survival rate is still low, especially the crab larvae stadia zoea until megalopa. Supplementation on rotifers and Artemia with fatty acids omega-3 HUFA and hormones ecdyson able to increase the survival rate. The aim of research to analyze the performance of developmental and larval survival rate of mud crab supplemented omega-3 fatty acids, Nannochloropsis and hormones ecdyson. The results of the research as an innovative engineering technology physiological mangrove crab larvae in order to increase the production of seed suistainable. This study will be conducted at the Research Station Maranak, Research and Development of Brackish Water Aquaculture Maros (BPPBAP Maros). Test animals used in the form of mangrove crab larvae stadia zoea-1. Aquarium research container in the form of capacity of 50 L. Larvae density of 50 larvae/L. Stage larval indeks and survival rate of test parameters. The study design in the form of RAL with 3 treatments namely omega-3 HUFA, hormon ecdyson, Nannocholoropsis and without supplementation as a control, 3 replicates that will be analyzed by ANOVA. The results showed that the type of material supplementation significantly (P<0.05) against the larval stage index and survival rate of mud crab larvae.

  • Analysis of sea surface temperature, salinity and current with the yellowfin tuna cathced on Western Halmahera Island Waters

    There are many oceanography parameters that affects migration and the presence of tuna in a waters such as temperature, salinity, sea current and sea waters fertility. A number of studies get that the distribution of tuna was predictable by analysis of those parameters at sea waters regularly and mapped to support the activity of localytuna fisheries. In the western of North Molucas waters, all of this parameter was predicted is also formed so that can be used as indicators of the presence of tuna. The study was conducted at the western water of Halmahera island over August to October 2015 with the objective of knowing the relationship between sea surface temperature, salinity and sea current to the tuna catched in this region. Data acquisition by using suvey method and analyzed by multiple linier regression analysis was expected to define the ralation between sea surface temperature, salinity, the sea current with the catch yellowfin the tuna. The results of the study got that in the jointing of the third oceanography factors being tested give significant impact to tuna catched with Fcount value is 3,317 with it's significant value is 0,000. But it is partial only two factors ocenographywho had have real impact on tuna catched, which are sea surface temperature and sea current at these waters.

  • Estimated value of economic losses caused water pollution on Mahakam Coastal area

    This study aimed to quantify the value of environmental damage caused by coastal development activities based on the cost of replacement the environment in the coastal Kutai Kertanegara. The data used in this study is the measurement of the field, interviews as well as data that originates in the department of Fisheries, Tourism and Local Government Kutai Kertanegara. Data were processed using the environment against the economic valuation approach coastal waters Kutai Kertanegara followed by dynamic analysis. The result showed that the Total Economic Value of mangrove ecosystems in the Mahakam Delta area with an area of ±150,000 ha is Rp. 4,203,100,332,500/year or Rp. 28,020,669/ha/year. The direct benefits of mangrove ecosystem that is used by people around the region provides the larges contribution of Rp. 1,871,967,115,-. Our simulation results show that the amount of comensation that incurred by each industry Rp. 2.254.196.642/year and impaired to Rp. 2.039.938.021/year, while the compensation/pollution tax for the loss in production that should be Rp. 214,941,877,125/year, borne by each of pollutant sources and community the mining industry worth USD 514,162,739/year.
